title: Welcome!
text:
Hi there! I’m Abhishek (pronounced “a-bhe(like he)-shake”). I am an Associate Professor of Statistics in the Department of Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science at Lawrence University, Appleton, Wisconsin. I am originally from Kolkata, India. I completed my Bachelors in Statistics from St. Xavier’s College, Kolkata, and my Masters from IIT, Kanpur. I earned my Ph.D. in Statistics from Iowa State University.
I enjoy teaching and relish being in the company of students. Please visit my teaching and research pages to learn more about my academic activities.
Outside the academic world, I enjoy running, biking, and going for hikes. My other interests include watching soccer as well as fiddling with my guitar.
